req.title: Reject player creation with invalid id type
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when POST /players/ receives an id that is not an integer.
triggers: reject player creation with invalid id type

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-035 requires HTTP 422 when POST /players/ receives an id that is not an integer. The PlayerRequestModel uses squad_number (int) as the key integer field; the model does not expose an 'id' field in the request body (id is UUID, server-generated). The requirement title says 'invalid id type' but the only client-supplied integer field is squad_number. We therefore test: (1) positive — valid integer squad_number yields 201 (EP, proves the happy path and that the validator accepts integers); (2) negative — string squad_number yields 422 (NEG/EP, core requirement); (3) boundary — float squad_number string yields 422 (BVA, near-integer non-integer type); (4) negative — boolean squad_number yields 422 (DT, booleans are int subclass in Python but Pydantic strict-ish coercion); (5) negative — null squad_number yields 422 (NEG, missing required int). Each test is self-contained, uses TestClient in-process, and asserts exact status codes to kill status-code constant mutations.

tests.name: test_post_player_valid_integer_squad_number_returns_201
preconditions: FastAPI app is importable via 'from main import app'
Database is pre-loaded with 26 fixture rows
squad_number 99 does not exist in the fixture data
actions: POST /players/ with a fully valid PlayerRequestModel payload where squad_number is an integer (99)
expected: Response body contains the created player with a UUID id field
trace: R-PLAYER-035: valid integer id type must NOT trigger 422
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_post_player_valid_integer_squad_number_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert "id" in body
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Player"

test_post_player_valid_integer_squad_number_returns_201()

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_post_player_missing_squad_number_returns_422():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
